candidates.source_title: The Mongol Princess No Man Could Defeat #history
candidates.source_description:
Khutulun was a Mongol princess, skilled warrior, and famous wrestler.

She reportedly had one condition for any man who wanted to marry her: he had to beat her in wrestling. If he lost, he owed her 100 horses.

Challenger after challenger failed, and according to later accounts, Khutulun ended up with thousands of horses — and no husband.

Khutulun, Mongol History, Women in History History, Warrior Princess
